categories.main_business_segments: Dongnan Electronics primarily engages in the design, research, production, and sales of micro switches and related components. Its main product lines include micro switches for household appliances, automotive applications, electric tools, and intelligent low-voltage electrical appliances. The company focuses on customized micro switches that meet various environmental and operational requirements such as high temperature, waterproofing, explosion-proofing, and dust resistance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced product structure design, precision mold design and manufacturing, and the application of new material combinations to enhance product performance. It emphasizes automated production lines and mature manufacturing processes, including laser welding and integrated injection molding. Quality control is rigorous, involving high-precision production and testing equipment to ensure reliability and compliance with international certifications like CB, CE, UL, and TÜV.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dongnan Electronics serves major customers in the household appliance industry, automotive sector, electric tools, and intelligent low-voltage electrical equipment. Its products are widely used in appliances such as microwaves, dishwashers, air conditioners, washing machines, refrigerators, and vacuum cleaners, as well as automotive components like central locks, windows, seat belts, and charging guns. The company maintains stable partnerships with well-known brands including Midea, Haier, Gree, Siemens, Bosch, Whirlpool, Panasonic, LG, Dyson, Hitachi, Toshiba, and BYD.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 83% of revenue. It also has a significant export business covering international markets, contributing approximately 16% of total sales. Dongnan Electronics has established a sales network including a subsidiary in Shanghai to expand market reach and improve service capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dongnan Electronics operates in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on manufacturing electronic components, specifically micro switches. It procures raw materials such as copper, silver, and plastics from upstream suppliers and sells finished components directly to downstream original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and distributors in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in micro switch technology, focusing on enhancing product durability, safety, and adaptability to harsh environments. R&D efforts target expanding product applications in emerging sectors like new energy vehicles and smart home devices. Dongnan Electronics invests in advanced manufacturing technologies, maintains a strong in-house R&D team, collaborates with academic institutions, and implements strict project management processes to accelerate product development and market responsiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of micro switch products and components to OEM customers and distributors. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by an agency distribution network. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from financial products, but the core revenue stream remains product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The micro switch industry is fragmented with many small-scale, low-end competitors focusing on price competition. Dongnan Electronics positions itself in the mid-to-high-end market segment, leveraging advanced technology, product quality, and strong customer relationships. It is recognized as a leading domestic manufacturer with a solid reputation and certifications, competing with international and domestic players in the electronic components sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Dongnan Electronics reported revenues of approximately RMB 318 million, representing a 22.27% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 45.8 million, up 17.38%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding sales volumes and product diversification. Total assets stood at around RMB 932 million with a net asset value of RMB 857 million, indicating a stable financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dongnan Electronics emphasizes high-quality, reliable micro switches with specialized features such as high sensitivity, fast action, and resistance to extreme conditions like high temperature, moisture, vibration, and dust. Its products are customized to meet specific client needs across diverse applications, providing safety and efficiency. The company’s competitive edge lies in its advanced R&D capabilities, comprehensive product range, strict quality control, and strong partnerships with leading brands, enabling it to deliver tailored solutions and maintain market leadership.
